question: What attainment becomes dear to the yoginīs as a result?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are joined as a compound.
A great accomplishment is the subject.
This accomplishment may become dear to the yoginīs.
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: The great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
